messages:
Eli: heads up — customer acct `org_0xA3F7` says free-trial credits never appeared on their account after support grant. Support console shows 'grant queued' then "applied" but ledger has no entry, customer hit 402 on API when they tried to use it.
Rebecca: can you paste the grant attempt id + any request ids? also screenshot of the console state would help :eyes:
Eli: attempt id `attempt-20260317-9f2a`, request_id `req_9e2b0c`. attaching console copy (snip): grant state -> "queued" then "applied", balance unchanged.
BackofficeBot: Grant job enqueued: job=grant-apply id=attempt-20260317-9f2a worker=backoffice-3
Dan: quick Q — did the backoffice worker return success before the ledger write completed? seeing lots of transient 502s yesterday.
Eli: logs from support-hand-off show this sequence. pasted raw lines:
```
[2026-03-17T15:02:03Z] INFO grant_service: apply_attempt attempt-20260317-9f2a started
[2026-03-17T15:02:04Z] INFO backoffice_worker: tombstone set for grant attempt-20260317-9f2a
[2026-03-17T15:02:07Z] ERROR ledger-client: POST /ledgers/entries 504 Gateway Timeout (request=req_9e2b0c)
[2026-03-17T15:02:07Z] INFO grant_service: marked attempt as applied (idempotent ack)
[2026-03-17T15:02:07Z] INFO backoffice_worker: job complete
```
Rebecca: that looks like the worker considered it done even though ledger write timed out. if the client ack path marks the attempt as applied we lose the write — bad.
Dan: we have an existing idempotency/tombstone design to prevent double ledgers. if tombstone was set but ledger write failed and attempt flagged applied, retries will short-circuit. need to check tombstone expiry/metadata.
Lee: how many customers impacted? is this isolated to this org or a broader roll? we need severity.
Eli: so far only 3 support tickets in the last 6h referencing the same symptom. all had grant attempts showing 'applied' in console without ledger entries. filing a CS incident: INC-2026-347
DeployBot: recent backoffice release v1.14.2 deployed 2026-03-17T14:45:12Z to backoffice workers
Rebecca: likely regression from v1.14.2 — can someone grep for tombstone shape change? Dan, can you check worker-retry logic around ledger-client timeouts?
Dan: on it. initial hypothesis: worker sets tombstone, calls ledger, gets gateway timeout, but because ledger client retries raised a transport error, the grant_service handler swallowed it and flipped state to 'applied' before confirming ledger id returned. pushing a debug patch now to log ledger write confirmation IDs.
Eli: customers need temporary fix — any manual reconciliation steps we can run from support safely? we want to avoid double-credits.
Rebecca: manual mitigation: (1) check tombstone exists for attempt; (2) if tombstone exists but no ledger entry, run `scripts/reconcile_grant --attempt attempt-20260317-9f2a --dry-run` to see diff; (3) if dry-run looks good, run without `--dry-run` which will insert ledger entry and annotate tombstone with ledger_id.
Dan: caution: current reconcile script assumes no race with live worker; recommend taking tombstone lock, run reconcile, then release. I'll add a small helper to take lock: `backoffice tools lock-tombstone --attempt ...`
Eli: pasted output of dry-run (sanitized):
```
> scripts/reconcile_grant --attempt attempt-20260317-9f2a --dry-run
reconcile: attempt=attempt-20260317-9f2a org=org_0xA3F7 amount=50 credits
ledger: NOT_FOUND
action: will write ledger entry id=ledger-20260317-559b
```
Lee: if only 3 customers, manual reconcile is OK for now. but we need a code fix fast and a safe rollback for v1.14.2 if more show up.
Rebecca: assigned to eng-infra for hotfix: TODOs — (A) add confirm-on-ledger-write before marking applied; (B) surface failed ledger writes in support console; (C) add reconcile helper to run atomically. add to eng-releases board and priority P1.
Dan: quick patch pushed to staging branch — changes to backoffice worker: don't set attempt state to 'applied' until ledger returns 2xx and ledger_id persisted. also add metrics `grant.ledger_write_failures`.
Eli: can we run a reconciler sweep for the last 24h to catch other affected attempts? I'll kick off after patch is tested.
DeployBot: rolling v1.14.3 (hotfix) to canary backoffice-3 now
Rebecca: action items for support: (1) contact the 3 affected customers with ETA and manual reconciliation offer; (2) link to incident INC-2026-347; (3) update tickets once reconcile completes.
Eli: I ran manual reconcile for org_0xA3F7 — ledger entry inserted, customer confirmed credits visible. mark ticket resolved after user verification.
Dan: follow-up: we should add an alert rule for mismatches between console-grant-state==applied and ledger entries count. I'll open a small PR.
Lee: good. if more than 5 customers you'll convert to full postmortem. keep me updated.
Eli: thanks all. tagging @Dan for follow-through and @Rebecca for release notes.
Rebecca: noted. I'll add release note entry and the mitigation steps to the internal KB.
DeployBot: deployment v1.14.3 succeeded on 2026-03-17T15:10:45Z to backoffice-3
Eli: closing loop — customer satisfied. will monitor for 24h and report back here.
